best_idea: An encounter room is a stacked instance: entering pushes the room over the saved parent position, the party is placed on the side it came from, foes are spawned fresh from the room record on every entry, the first member to leave picks the exit edge, and leaving pops back to the parent and clears the room.
decision_why: Keep the stack-with-parent and the reset-on-entry spawn; drop the single-party exit-edge rule unless Frankendom gets groups; keep the room flag that stops a clear from ending the fight, as data. Donor has one party only, so no per-party instancing is modelled.
acceptance: A test enters a room from the south and asserts the player starts on a south slot; clearing every foe in a room flagged no-auto-end does not end the room until the player steps off an edge; leaving and re-entering spawns the same foe list again from data; a second member leaving by another edge is refused.
